name: highlight-text
title: Highlight text
description: A paragraph that fades in word by word, then a marker sweeps behind each phrase written between *asterisks*, one after another, turning it dark on the accent; held, then faded out. The asterisks are not shown. Transparent, with light text for dark backgrounds; set Ink to a dark colour for bright ones.

variables.label: Text (*asterisks* mark highlights)
variables.default: Verdandi sends every task to the *cheapest model* that can *finish it*, and remembers *what worked* for next time.
